readout_other: two-photon calcium imaging of astrocytes (GCaMP6f) and neurons (jRGECO1a)
direction_notes: In awake mice FUS enhanced astrocyte calcium transients and suppressed neuronal calcium activity; both effects were blunted under light isoflurane.
safety_notes: Thermocouple in cortex of harvested brain showed no temperature increase from 1 min of FUS relative to no FUS.

exposures.label: FUS to S1 cortex, 0.91 W/cm2 at 5% DC and 1.5 W/cm2 at 10% DC

target.label: somatosensory cortex of both awake and lightly anesthetized mice

timing.protocol_description: 1 min of FUS at 5% duty cycle, 0.91 W/cm2 Isppa or 10% duty cycle, 1.5 W/cm2 Isppa, within a 3 min imaging recording (1 min before, during, after).

source_quotes.n_subjects: n = 1567 (No FUS), 1377 (0.91 W/cm<sup>2</sup>) and 1636 (1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup>) astrocyte responsive events from 7 awake mice.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The FUS was delivered at a foundamental frequency of 0.521MHz and spatial-peak pulseaverage intensity (I<sub>SPPA</sub>) of 0.91 or 1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: Mice were stimulated with or without focused ultrasound for 1min under the 5% duty cycle, 0.91 W/cm<sup>2</sup> spatial-peak pulse-average intensity $\left( \mathrm { { I } _ { \mathrm { { S P P A } } } } \right)$ or 10% duty cycle, 1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> I<sub>SPPA</sub>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Mice were stimulated with or without focused ultrasound for 1min under the 5% duty cycle, 0.91 W/cm<sup>2</sup> spatial-peak pulse-average intensity $\left( \mathrm { { I } _ { \mathrm { { S P P A } } } } \right)$ or 10% duty cycle, 1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> I<sub>SPPA</sub>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.isppa_w_cm2: Mice were stimulated with or without focused ultrasound for 1min under the 5% duty cycle, 0.91 W/cm<sup>2</sup> spatial-peak pulse-average intensity $\left( \mathrm { { I } _ { \mathrm { { S P P A } } } } \right)$ or 10% duty cycle, 1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> I<sub>SPPA</sub>.

flags.reason: Only per-cohort counts given (7 awake and 5 anaesthetised mice for astrocytes; 10 awake and 13 anaesthetised for neurons); animals may overlap, total not stated.
Isppa quoted for the transducer measured by hydrophone beneath the coverslip in a water tank; domain not explicitly stated per value. Two intensities paired with 5% and 10% duty cycle.
PRF and pulse duration not stated in the main text.
'No FUS' condition recorded with imaging; paper does not say whether transducer was in place.
Authors say pulsed and smoothed waveforms were used to eliminate auditory confound; they cannot exclude auditory contributions.
Transducer described as customized/ring-shaped; maker or builder not stated.
